name: Reverse Robin: Second To Finale
source:
"He got served bad food, was rejected by a beautiful girl he just met, sees a poster for a missing pencil, and many more weird mishaps and revelations."

Reverse Robin was originally a NaNoRenO project in 2013. Reverse Robin: Second to Finale is an enhanced version which has corrected typos, added sound affects, and includes a few new sentences at the end so it doesn't end abruptly.

[Edited from [url=https://tofu-sheets-visual.itch.io/reverse-robin-second-to-finale]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“他吃到的食物很糟糕，被刚认识的一个漂亮女孩拒绝了，看到了一张丢失铅笔的海报，还有更多奇怪的事故和启示。”

Reverse Robin最初是NaNoRenO 2013年的项目。Reverse Robin: Second to Finale是一个增强版本，它纠正了拼写错误，添加了声音效果，并在结尾添加了一些新句子，这样它就不会突然结束。

[编辑自[url=https://tofu-sheets-visual.itch.io/reverse-robin-second-to-finale]Itch.io[/url]]
